messages.text: Remember my weekly equipment handoff arrangement: the receiving desk is west reception, the regular day is Thursday, and the handoff time is 09:20. This is an ongoing arrangement.

Keep a separate ongoing access note: the backup key for the imaging room is in locker L-9. This does not change the weekly equipment handoff arrangement. Save it as a note; do not schedule an alert or take a business action.
What are my regular equipment handoff arrangement and the backup-key location? Include all details you have retained.
